# Part V: Forensic Tests {.unnumbered}

This part brings together the tests that auditors run again and again on transaction data. Check the records against the rules. Look for amounts that have been made up. Find duplicates, exact and fuzzy, and link records of the same person across lists. Find gaps in numbered sequences. Rebuild a process from a system's audit trail and see whether its steps were followed.

Each test produces a list of exceptions. An exception is a lead, to be verified against the records. It is not yet a finding.

The chapters can be read in any order, once Parts I and II are done.
